name: cirrus
description: Daylight and glass: a cool near-white page, white cards on wide soft shadows, pill buttons, and every floating layer — menus, popovers, dialogs, sheets — frosted. Ink-navy is the action; one sky blue is the signal, with mint beside it in charts.

source.note: Screens of a Korean startup-legal marketing site shared by the owner, 2026-09-18. Design values only — the pale sky gradients, the frosted chips floating over photographs, the wide soft shadows under white cards, the near-black pill CTA and the blue/mint pairing in the diagnostic charts. No product's marks, wording or screen layouts are reproduced.
